# WavTokenizer official decode fixture

This fixture was generated by
`tools/parity/wavtokenizer/dump_reference.py` from the official
`jishengpeng/WavTokenizer` implementation at commit
`5cf440d91ac420ca338f117b7003a77450d64730`. The script verifies the public
GGUF SHA-256 before loading its verbatim F32 state dict into the upstream
modules, then calls the official `codes_to_features` and `decode` methods.

Regenerate from `tools/parity/`:

```sh
uv run --frozen python wavtokenizer/dump_reference.py \
  --source /path/to/jishengpeng-WavTokenizer \
  --gguf /path/to/wavtokenizer-large.gguf \
  --codes ../../crates/vokra-models/tests/fixtures/wavtokenizer/codes.u32le \
  --condition-id 0 \
  --output /tmp/wavtokenizer-reference
```

The four-code fixture is deliberately small enough to commit while still
executing codebook lookup, every positional ResNet, full temporal attention,
all 12 ConvNeXt blocks, the magnitude/phase head, and same-padded iSTFT.
